sourceAnchors.message: Ensure that resources like this ExecutorService object are closed after use
sourceAnchors.reason: The executor is released in unconditional finally shutdownNow plus asserted finite awaitTermination10SECONDS. TWR.close waits indefinitely and would reintroduce BUG2833. Failure/cancellation remains failed PT.

sourceAnchors.message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.
sourceAnchors.reason: Plain JUnit immutable-record 64-task fixture, not J2EE/Web thread creation. Original all Futures have get10SECONDS; unconditional finally shutdownNow with asserted awaitTermination10SECONDS owns worker termination. No Root/DB/child/authority operations.
